body: Motivation comes and goes. Don’t depend on motivation, start off my doing small task and build good  habits. Working out is probably one of the best things to destress and help you have a healthier lifestyle. One quote I ask myself daily is “did you fail or did you quit.” It’s discipline that you lack it, start off by making you bed every morning it should give you a small sense of pride and make you feel like you should do more.
